name: Mani, Inc.
summary: Mani, Inc. engages in the manufacture and distribution of medical devices in Japan, Asia, Europe, North America, and internationally. It operates in three segments: Surgical Products, Eyeless Needle Products, and Dental Products. The company offers surgical instruments, such as opthalmic knives, vitreous forceps, skin staplers, and trocars; eyeless needles; and dental products, including reamers and files, dia-burs, NiTi rotary file, as well as dental restorative materials. Mani, Inc. was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Utsunomiya, Japan.
